Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in interpreting the search results provided by the WebSurfer. The WebSurfer clearly displayed a Wikipedia snippet stating, "Jeremy Oxley grew up in the northern New South Wales town of Kingscliff," which directly answers the question about his birthplace/upbringing location (Kingscliff). However, the Planner ignored this specific detail and instead focused on the metadata from a different source (CelebrityHow) that listed "Born 15 November 1961, Sydney, New South Wales, Australia." By prioritizing the "Born" field from a less detailed snippet over the explicit biographical narrative in the Wikipedia abstract found in the same view, the Planner arrived at the incorrect answer of Sydney instead of the correct answer, Kingscliff.
